document: Alone Against the Dark Defying the Triumph of the Ice (A Solo Play Call of Cthulhu Mini Campaign) Chaosium Publication 23154 (Matthew Costello, Mike Mason, Petr Štovik etc.) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
The winds have exposed skeletons of men, horses, and camels—
perhaps victims of some ancient vendetta. A jeweled dagger 
catches your eye. You’ll be able to sell it in Cairo for $100—if 
you make it back! 
Drink another day’s water ration and choose a direction: for 
North, go to 268; for East, go to 257; for South, go to 255; for 
West, go to 299.
(255, 257, 268, 299)
